compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: The LORD asks Moses to receive offerings from willing hearts and commands a sanctuary made according to the shown pattern so he may dwell among Israel.
observations.label: A willing contribution prepares a sanctuary

observations.body: A willing contribution prepares a sanctuary belongs to tablets and dwelling in the Sinai trail.
observations.label: Where this sits

observations.body: Exodus 25:1–9 supplies consequence evidence for the event’s developing sequence.
observations.label: What follows from Sinai

observations.body: The tablets and dwelling instructions develop the consequences of Sinai presence; they are not additional lines inside the Ten Words.
observations.label: Reading boundary

payload.posture: Read Exodus 25:1–9 as its own source before carrying it into the wider Sinai trail.
payload.tension: A willing contribution prepares a sanctuary follows from Sinai while remaining distinct from the words and actions at the mountain itself.
